title: feed.xml must declare RSS version 2.0

spec.name: RSS 2.0
spec.normative_quote: At the top level, a RSS document is a <rss> element, with a mandatory attribute called version, that specifies the version of RSS that the document conforms to. If it conforms to this specification, the version attribute must be 2.0.
spec.note: Verified against the RSS Advisory Board's numbered 2.0.11 archive.

applicability: A well-formed XML document with an <rss><channel> structure.

cases.name: an RSS document declares the wrong version
